Settings.privacyPolicyContent2: United Against Sexual Violence ("us", "we", or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.
Settings.privacyPolicyContent3: We may collect information from you directly, such as when you create an account, report an incident (if you choose not to report anonymously), or contact us. This may include your name, email address, and location data (with your permission).
Settings.privacyPolicyContent4: Your information is used to provide you with our services, improve the app, communicate with you, and send security alerts. We may use aggregated, anonymous data for research and analysis.
Settings.termsOfServiceDesc: Read about our terms of service.
Settings.termsOfServiceContent2: Please read these Terms of Service ("Terms") carefully. By using the United Against Sexual Violence application ("App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms.
Settings.termsOfServiceContent3: You agree to use this App only for lawful and intended purposes. You agree not to misuse the emergency SOS feature, which should only be used in situations of genuine and immediate danger. The App is not intended for use by children under the age of 13.
Settings.termsOfServiceContent4: If you submit any content, such as reports or feedback, you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, and display that content, subject to our Privacy Policy. You agree not to post any content that is illegal, defamatory, or harmful.
